chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
It is strange that the jealous do not feel jealous about bodily health.

key_terms.سَلاَمَةِ الْأَجْسَادِ: Health and safety of the bodies

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the irony of jealousy and health?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) observes that the envious person is so consumed by the perceived perfection of others that they neglect their own physical well-being, a phenomenon known in Shia ethics as the self-destructive nature of *hasad*. This highlights how spiritual malaise manifests physically, as the heart's fixation on external attributes leads to internal decay and neglect of the body, which is an amanah (trust) from God.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 225. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
It is strange that the jealous do not feel jealous about bodily health. [1]
